name: aiCarousels
description: aiCarousels is a free carousel maker and generator for creating social media carousels posts for platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok.
content:
What is AICarousels?

AICarousels is a free social media carousel generator. The AI tool is the fastest way to create social media carousels for LinkedIn, Instagram & TikTok. It features an AI writing assistant, custom templates, and presets.

Why use AICarousels?

Carousel posts are one of the highest-converting content types on LinkedIn. However, creating a PDF slide deck takes a lot of time. AIcarousels allows you to create LinkedIn carousels in seconds using AI. Turn a topic, text, video, website, YouTube video, or PDF into a LinkedIn carousel with one click.

Pricing

AICarousels is mostly free to use: Access a wide range of our features for free, enabling you to create professional-looking carousels without any cost.

To remove the watermark, unlimited downloads, and AI features, the PRO plan will cost you $14.95/month.
